_doc: Golden transcripts for eval_golden_call.py — the LIVE-LLM merge gate for any soul/prompt change. Each bucket is a scripted multi-turn user-utterance list + a seed spec (tier, card, has_catalogue, channel: voice|chat) + the structural PROPERTIES the resulting transcript must hold. channel='chat' drives runtime.run_turn (the WhatsApp mouth) — the SAME job brief must drive both mouths. Buckets are SHORT (2-3 turns) to bound token cost. Properties are STRUCTURAL (gate verdicts, marker/echo counts, no-repeat) NOT phrasings — a phrasing assertion would flap on model variance. The 2026-07-25 opening buckets encode Peter's four normal openings (smalltalk / hypothetical order / what-can-you-do / describes-business) + the anti-myopia carry case (declines X, must still carry X two turns later). caller='creator' is special: the eval drives it with a real ROCOTO_CREATOR_NUMBERS number so the tier resolves to creator (tier is a pure function of the number).
